name: Suno v4
description: Leading AI music generation model creating full songs from text prompts.
longDescription: Suno v4 generates complete, high-quality songs including vocals, instrumentals, and lyrics from simple text prompts. It supports diverse genres and styles, producing near-professional-quality audio with remarkable musicality and coherence.

codeSnippets.label: Python
codeSnippets.code:
import requests

response = requests.post(
    "https://apibox.erweima.ai/api/v1/generate",
    headers={"Authorization": "Bearer $SUNO_API_KEY", "Content-Type": "application/json"},
    json={"prompt": "A happy jazz song about coding", "style": "jazz"}
)
print(response.json())
